paper.title_en: Quasinormal modes of Kerr--Newman--de Sitter black hole: Linear stability and strong cosmic censorship conjecture
paper.abstract_en: We present an alternative formulation of coupled gravitational and electromagnetic perturbations of Kerr--Newman--de Sitter black holes, yielding decoupled radial and angular equations with a well-defined $Λ\rightarrow 0$ limit. We compute the quasinormal mode spectra using spectral and direct integration methods, finding excellent agreement. All of these modes are consistent with the linear stability of the Kerr--Newman--de Sitter black hole. We investigate the photon sphere and near-extremal modes, revealing a non-trivial interplay between rotation and electric charge. We further explore the implications for the strong cosmic censorship conjecture and find that the photon sphere modes predominantly determine its validity within the parameter space considered. While increasing the rotation of the black hole generally favours the strong cosmic censorship conjecture, increasing the electric charge can promote its violation. We also find that the region of parameter space exhibiting a violation of the conjecture is comparatively smaller for gravitational perturbations than for electromagnetic perturbations. These results highlight the important role of rotation, electric charge, and the nature of perturbations in determining the validity of the strong cosmic censorship conjecture in Kerr--Newman--de Sitter spacetimes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文针对Kerr-Newman-de Sitter黑洞的引力与电磁耦合扰动给出解耦的径向与角向方程（具有明确的Λ→0极限），并用谱方法与直接积分法交叉验证准正规模谱，进而讨论旋转、电荷与扰动类型对强宇宙监督猜想有效性的影响。主题与广义相对论基础中的宇宙监督问题直接相关，理论深度与方法交叉验证信号较强，适合点开细读。
decision.title_zh: Kerr–Newman–de Sitter黑洞的准正规模：线性稳定性与强宇宙监督猜想
decision.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Kerr–Newman–de Sitter黑洞引力与电磁耦合扰动的一种替代表述，得到了解耦的径向与角向方程，并具有定义良好的$Λ\rightarrow 0$极限。我们使用谱方法和直接积分方法计算准正规模谱，发现两者高度一致。所有这些模式均与Kerr–Newman–de Sitter黑洞的线性稳定性相符。我们研究了光子球模式和近极端模式，揭示了旋转与电荷之间非平凡的相互影响。我们进一步探讨了其对强宇宙监督猜想的含义，并发现光子球模式在所考虑的参数空间内主要决定该猜想的有效性。虽然增加黑洞的旋转通常有利于强宇宙监督猜想，但增加电荷可能促使其被违反。我们还发现，对于引力扰动，出现该猜想被违反的参数空间区域比电磁扰动情形相对更小。这些结果凸显了旋转、电荷以及扰动性质在决定Kerr–Newman–de Sitter时空中强宇宙监督猜想有效性方面的重要作用。
